topic: Định vị tự hiểu và thiết kế đời sống

options.label: Bounded self-understanding and life-design positioning
options.scope: Position the system as reflective decision support with explicit limits; exclude diagnosis, destiny and guaranteed outcomes.
tradeoffs: Preserves the product vision and action orientation
Requires disciplined claim review across every surface

options.label: Educational wellbeing content only
options.scope: Restrict the offer to static education and journaling without individualized interpretations.
tradeoffs: Lowest claim risk
Removes much of the differentiated personalized value

options.label: Pause positioning and run discovery
options.scope: Do not freeze a public position until user research and legal review are complete.
tradeoffs: Reduces premature commitment
Delays taxonomy, copy, product contracts and demo acceptance

recommendation_rationale: It preserves the stated vision while creating a reviewable boundary between reflection and prohibited scientific, medical or deterministic claims.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Requires ongoing Editorial, Method, Privacy and Legal review

Every public claim must map to a product/method/content release

topic: 9 cấp/12 lớp/4 phần/12 trường/K01–20

options.label: Lock the 9-level/12-layer/4-block/12-field/K01-K20 model as a versioned taxonomy
options.scope: Keep the complete model, publish definitions and version every semantic change.
tradeoffs: Preserves all original vision and trace IDs
Creates broad governance and regression-test obligations

options.label: Lock nine levels only and defer lower taxonomies
options.scope: Use nine levels now; treat layers, blocks, fields and K families as research-only.
tradeoffs: Smaller initial contract
Delays report differentiation and method mapping

options.label: Redesign the taxonomy before implementation
options.scope: Replace the current hierarchy after a dedicated research cycle.
tradeoffs: May simplify the model
Breaks current product/report/trace mappings and delays development

recommendation_rationale: Versioning retains all requested concepts without representing the taxonomy as validated science and gives downstream schemas stable identifiers.
recommendation_tradeoffs: More documentation and migration discipline
Definitions must be testable and cannot remain marketing labels

decision_due_event: before schema, API and nine-level report contracts are frozen
constraints: Taxonomy status is conceptual until evidence says otherwise

topic: Method độc lập theo nguồn và phiên bản

options.label: Independent versioned method releases
options.scope: Release each method by source, rights, formula, tests, limits and named approvers.
tradeoffs: Strong provenance and selective withdrawal
Higher registry and review overhead

options.label: One bundled method release
options.scope: Approve the whole method set under one version and review.
tradeoffs: Simpler packaging
A defect or rights issue can block or taint the entire bundle

options.label: Content-only mode with no calculation methods
options.scope: Keep method descriptions but disable computed or individualized outputs.
tradeoffs: Lowest execution and rights risk
Cannot deliver the intended analytic product depth

recommendation_rationale: Per-method releases provide the minimum isolation needed for rights, corrections, rollback and level-specific eligibility.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Requires a release registry and independent review per method
Some catalog products remain unavailable while individual methods are blocked

cost_impact.planning_effect: Cost varies by source rights, expert review and test depth for each method.

decision_due_event: before any method result is eligible for a product or report
constraints: No release without source/right/formula/test/limit evidence
Withdrawal must invalidate dependent jobs, reports and exports

topic: Entitlement khác quyền và đủ dữ liệu

options.label: Separate entitlement, authorization, eligibility and data sufficiency
options.scope: Evaluate each server-side and return typed denial or missing-data reasons.
tradeoffs: Correct security and user guidance
More policy states and negative tests

options.label: Treat entitlement as sufficient access
options.scope: A paid entitlement opens a product whenever the route exists.
tradeoffs: Simpler commerce logic
Unsafe because payment does not prove subject rights, purpose or data sufficiency

options.label: Manual eligibility review for every request
options.scope: A reviewer approves each access and run.
tradeoffs: Strong human control
Does not scale and increases sensitive-data handling

recommendation_rationale: The four-way separation prevents payment or a client flag from becoming authorization and supports precise recovery states.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Requires a policy engine and cross-layer test matrix
More blocked states must be designed across mobile and desktop

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A adds policy, authorization and cross-device state work; provider-independent estimates remain in person-days only.

decision_due_event: before entitlement, profile, analysis or report authorization contracts are frozen
constraints: Client-supplied IDs or flags cannot grant access
Every denial must avoid object-existence leakage

topic: Dừng điểm giả và cho null

options.label: Typed null, unknown, withheld and not-applicable results
options.scope: Preserve uncertainty and block unsupported derived scores while allowing partial truthful reports.
tradeoffs: Prevents fabricated certainty
Requires more schema and UI states

options.label: Impute fallback scores
options.scope: Fill missing values from defaults or heuristics.
tradeoffs: Fewer visible gaps
Creates false precision and unsafe downstream inferences

options.label: Fail the entire report on any missing input
options.scope: Return no result until every field is present.
tradeoffs: Simple consistency rule
Unnecessarily blocks safe partial value and encourages coerced data entry

recommendation_rationale: Typed absence is the only option consistent with the plan's evidence discipline and differentiated report contracts.
recommendation_tradeoffs: Every formula and narrative path needs null behavior
Users require clear explanations of what is missing and why

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A increases schema, fixture, UI and report-regression work.

decision_due_event: before formula, result and report schemas are accepted
constraints: Unknown is never converted to zero
AI cannot infer or narrate unavailable deterministic values

topic: Numbers là tham chiếu không đo số phận

options.label: Numbers as bounded symbolic reference
options.scope: Allow clearly labeled symbolic interpretation with sources, limitations and no fate or clinical claim.
tradeoffs: Retains the original Numbers concept
Needs prominent limitations and cultural/claim review

options.label: Numbers as predictive life metric
options.scope: Use numeric outputs to predict traits, compatibility or outcomes.
tradeoffs: Strong marketing differentiation
Unacceptable unsupported and potentially harmful inference risk

options.label: Remove Numbers from the active portfolio
options.scope: Keep historical material only and do not expose the method.
tradeoffs: Lowest claim risk
Discards a material part of the product vision

recommendation_rationale: A bounded reference mode keeps the vision visible without treating symbolic arithmetic as measurement or destiny.
recommendation_tradeoffs: May reduce persuasive marketing language
Some users may still over-interpret results, requiring UX safeguards

cost_impact.planning_effect: Option A requires source/right review, careful copy and misuse testing.

topic: Báo cáo cấu trúc không filler

tradeoffs: High traceability and genuine level differentiation
Largest template and regression surface

options.label: One universal report template
options.scope: Reuse a single report structure and vary only length or content.
tradeoffs: Lower authoring cost
Risks filler and fails nine-level differentiation

options.label: Free-form AI narrative
options.scope: Let the model compose reports without a fixed schema.
tradeoffs: Fast experimentation
Cannot reliably prove provenance, limits, corrections or stable outputs

recommendation_rationale: The structured approach is required to avoid filler and to separate deterministic facts, interpretation, uncertainty and action.

topic: Privacy, auth, delete từ đầu

topic: Tám bộ nền từ source/runtime khóa

topic: Quarantine experimental_legacy

tradeoffs: Preserves forensic value and prevents unsafe reuse

options.label: Retain legacy behind a feature flag
options.scope: Allow reactivation through runtime configuration.
tradeoffs: Easy fallback
Feature flags can bypass product, rights and safety review

options.label: Delete all legacy material

tradeoffs: Eliminates accidental execution

topic: Passport/rights/tests/limits/approver

tradeoffs: Highest provenance and selective control
More work before each method becomes eligible

options.label: Provisional method release with partial packet

tradeoffs: Faster experimentation
Normalizes missing evidence and complicates withdrawal

options.label: One product-level approval covers all methods
options.scope: Treat product approval as authorization for every included method.
tradeoffs: Simple governance
Cannot isolate rights, defect or limitation changes

options.label: No free tier

Raises trust and adoption barriers
